title: Insert a name into a selector
summary: Interpolation puts a variable value inside a selector name.
introduction: Interpolation puts a variable value inside a selector name. Your task: Change the theme name to ocean.
learningObjectives: Change the theme name to ocean.
Explain the example for insert a name into a selector

blocks.text: Interpolation puts a variable value inside a selector name. It can make a named theme class.
Use Less 4 on your computer. Install Node.js first. Save examples as lesson.less, then run npx lessc lesson.less lesson.css. The browser loads lesson.css; this site does not build Less.

blocks.title: Insert a name into a selector

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `@{theme}` inserts the Less variable value into the selector name, instead of writing the literal word theme.
Tailwind's `@theme` block names design values. A `--color-...` name creates matching colour utilities.

blocks.text: The output selector is .garden-card. It has a green border.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use @{name} inside the selector text. Plain @name is used for a whole property value.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the theme name to ocean.
